title: Pete Jolly Trio Yours Truly SIGNED Autographed CD 1993 Quartet QCD 1007 Jazz
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. SIGNED in black marker on the back insert. Disc, jewel case, and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
The Pete Jolly Trio - Yours Truly (Quartet Records QCD 1007, 1993). Live digital recording.

SIGNED: the back insert is autographed in black marker by pianist Pete Jolly. The signature is shown in the photos. Sold as-is with no certificate of authenticity - please judge the signature from the photos.

The Pete Jolly Trio:
Pete Jolly, piano
Chuck Berghofer, bass
Nick Martinis, drums

12 tracks:
1. Speak Low
2. While My Lady Sleeps
3. You Stepped Out of a Dream
4. Like Someone in Love
5. On Green Dolphin Street
6. Dear Old Stockholm
7. Darn That Dream
8. Little Bird
9. A Gal in Calico
10. Old Folks
11. You and the Night and the Music
12. Stardust (verse)

Disc, jewel case, and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
